title: Expose canonical read-only Case Queue filters/sorting in native browser and preserve applied-page Inspector authorization
goal: Make the existing owner-authorized native Case Queue status/owner/freshness filters and allowed sort usable from the opt-in browser; keep search, pagination, and independently reauthorized Inspector selection bound to the same last submitted filter/sort snapshot, without another backend search engine or security model.
invariants: Status, owner, freshness and sort are client-side presentation controls passed verbatim only to EXISTING first-party GET /case-queue query allowlist; server's per-object Case/Incident/Finding authorization and Saved View sanitization remain sole authority.
On Search/Apply, capture one immutable applied query/filter/sort snapshot; use exactly that snapshot for current cursor page and independent exact-ID Inspector GET until next submit or Clear.
Changing filter input without submitting never changes the current page ACL or selected-case reauthorization query; submit/clear/pagehide abort and clear sensitive selection.
No tenant/environment/permission, Saved View snapshot, Case mutation, export, speculative client-side result filtering, new index or full Shared Inspector duplication.
security_properties: Current server host independently reauthorizes each page, filters/sorts server side, and separately reauthorizes Inspect under identical applied q/status/owner/freshness/sort and cursor.
Denied/stale search or inspector request wipes protected rows/details; apply/reset invalidate previous page cursor, selected details, in-flight requests and prior trusted state.
Inputs are bounded and only exact existing server-supported filter/sort names are emitted; no scope or permission selector; inert textContent remains sole sink.

migration.rationale: Opt-in same-origin host-mounted static browser with no changed persistence or Case schema

rollback.strategy: Stop using NewAuthorizedQueueBrowserHandler and use existing native authorized Queue HTTP handler
verification: Existing GET Case Queue and POST return routes remain available
No data persisted in browser or backend

inputs: Canonical CAP-INV-101 §§3/8/11/12/17/25 requires permission-aware Case Queue search, filters, sort and Inspector selection.

Existing server-side authorized filter/sort engine E10-INV-101I-FILTERS and pagination E10-INV-101M-PAGE already tested, with current opt-in browser/Inspector in parent PR #149 frozen SHA c73f05b16a72af97c9845cbf4e4624baf9052c9f.
outputs: A native accessible Apply filters control for literal status, owner, freshness and allowed sort, consumed by the already trusted server GET API with no new filtering engine.
Search/page/Inspect all share last applied filter snapshot; reset clears these controls, selection, and cursor; denied pages cannot retain inaccessible Case data.
acceptance_tests: Node DOM actual browser script test: Apply status/owner/freshness/sort produces native server query with exact allowlisted names, and next cursor remains bound to that projection.
Node DOM test: changing a filter input without submitting cannot change authorization context of Inspector GET; exactly old applied controls and exact Case ID/cursor transmitted.
Node DOM test: Clear purges all controls, cursor, page and selected sensitive data; existing denied/revoked Inspector and no HTML injection tests still pass.
Exact-head GitHub engineering-kernel mandatory CHK-MANIFESTS, CHK-CASE-QUEUE-CONTRACT and CHK-SECURITY-TESTS >=90%, no waiver.

performance_budget.rationale: Filter change causes the same single existing reauthorized Queue request; inspect causes one current independently reauthorized request; pagination remains 25 Case rows, backend existing 5000 candidate bound.
metrics: No additional network fetch until Apply/Clear
One existing projection request per applied filter or cursor change
One independent source-authorized Inspect request on explicit click

definition_of_ready: Parent R browser and existing server I filters/sort and M page were implemented on frozen SHA and had exact-head CI pass; product maintains native read-only Class-0 scope.
No production IAM or full Shared Inspector required for a bounded user-applied filter and sort journey.
definition_of_done: Commit coherent tested UI filter/sort path, publish manifest/handoff and exact CI result on a child draft PR with base/head tracked.
One independent read-only L2 for new browser/Inspector authorization-boundary integration if stable, no claim of CAP-INV-101 full acceptance or merge.
